title: Ain el Hammam
description: AAA recorded a prehistoric site in a ravine and a separate Roman site on a height, both south of this spring. BAtlas placed a settlement symbol for the Roman site roughly coincident with what is now the modern town of Sidi Lakhdar in Algeria's Mostaganem province.
